headword: {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}
reading: にっぽんぎんこうけん
gloss: Bank of Japan note; Japanese banknote

definitions.gloss: Bank of Japan note; Japanese banknote
definitions.explanation: The official designation for paper money issued by the Bank of Japan. The phrase appears printed on every Japanese banknote, just above the denomination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: "Bank of Japan Note" is printed on the bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New Bank of Japan notes have been issued.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法定通貨|ほうていつうか}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Bank of Japan notes are Japan's legal tender.

notes:
The formal legal name for Japanese paper currency. In daily life people simply say ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧ (banknote) or ⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧ (bill); {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん} appears mainly on the bills themselves and in financial or legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}{発行高|はっこうだか}: amount of Bank of Japan notes in circulation
- {新|しん}{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}: new-design Bank of Japan notes
- ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧{日本銀行券|にっぽんぎんこうけん}: old-design Bank of Japan notes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧: banknote — everyday term
- ⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧: bill — colloquial
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: coin — issued by the government, not the Bank of Japan
